ai/npc/VarkaSilenosSupport/31380-friend..text: Grocer Diyabu: Oh! Are you the soldier I've been hearing so much about?! My name is Diyabu. As you can see, I'm a businessman. If you ever need anything, just let me know. I'll try my best to accommodate you. A hero like you deserves the best!

ai/npc/VarkaSilenosSupport/31380-no.html.text: Grocer Diyabu: Dear traveler of the west wind. I must tell you! I deal with friends of Varka only!
